name: Cabo Verde
regionLevel: first-level division (ISO 3166-2), as in the N-Ways regions table

existing.system: Correios de Cabo Verde 4-digit postcodes written before the locality, plus P.O. boxes ('C.P.' / 'Caixa Postal'), e.g. 'Rua 5 de Julho 138/Platô, C.P. 38, 7600 PRAIA, SANTIAGO, CABO VERDE'. Codes are area-level (town or zone), not door-level: Praia 7600-7602, Mindelo 2110, Espargos 4110, Santa Maria 4111, Sal Rei 5110, São Filipe 8220.
existing.status: Area postcodes exist but are mostly used for mail and forms. People give directions by zone (bairro), street and landmark; many streets have names and some doors have numbers in city centres (Platô, Mindelo). No national door-level digital address system was found; a 'Morada Única' national address register could not be confirmed, and correios.cv was unreachable on 2026-10-17, so no public postcode lookup was found.
existing.openData: No open national address or postcode dataset found. OpenStreetMap addresses in Cabo Verde carry addr:postcode values (as Nominatim shows), so OSM can supply the area code (ODbL, attribution required). The Overpass count of addr:housenumber could not be run.
existing.openAlgorithm: Open Location Code (Plus Codes) is open (Apache-2.0) and works offline.
existing.terms: No licence terms published for Correios postcodes.
existing.recommendation: Use coordinates plus Plus Codes (nways.ng/p/<code>) as the shareable address, described by island, municipality, zone and landmark (e.g. 'Achada Santo António, Praia · perto da Caixa'). Show the 4-digit postcode as area context only (from OSM), and do not treat it as a location. Island matters: always show which island a place is on, because the same names recur across islands (Ribeira Grande, Tarrafal, Santa Catarina, São Filipe vs São Filipe in Praia).

sources.note: UPU addressing sheet for Cabo Verde (04/2014): 4-digit postcode left of the locality name, e.g. '7600 PRAIA'; P.O. box 'C.P. 38'; island name on its own line

Nominatim search 2026-10-17 (Overpass API was unreachable): OSM addresses carry 4-digit postcodes, e.g. Praia 7600/7601/7602, Mindelo 2110, Espargos 4110, Santa Maria 4111, Sal Rei 5110, São Filipe 8220
Address example 'Av. Cidade de Lisboa, Praia, Caixa Postal Nº 237A'

sources.buildings: OpenStreetMap (ODbL); Google Open Buildings (CC BY 4.0) and Microsoft building footprints (ODbL) via Overture Maps
